    minr, maxr = min(r for r,c in pts), max(r for r,c in pts)
    minc, maxc = min(c for r,c in pts), max(c for r,c in pts)
    # For each horizontal row of the shape, preserve its bottom edge; shift
    # the side-wall cells along diagonals toward the lower center.
    for r,c in pts:
        out[r][c] = 0
    for c in range(minc, maxc+1):
